full_sentence: Although the message was short, it made me feel better.

options.text: so I did not reply at all.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part.

options.text: I wrote it on my phone.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about the message but does not express the contrast expected after 'although'.

options.text: it took me a long time to type.
options.why_wrong: This describes the effort but does not provide the contrasting result that 'although' requires.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners often pick a result clause with 'so' because it feels like a simple logical link.
translation: Chociaż wiadomość była krótka, sprawiła, że poczułem się lepiej.
